name: music_visualizers
description: Listening test: per-line visualizers — open Ctrl+M to watch pianoroll strips
script: announce VISUALIZER TESTS — watch the Music Drawer (Ctrl+M)
strudel edit c4 e4 g4 c5.pianoroll() cps=0.5
announce 2/6: Two pianorolls — melody vs bass
strudel edit melody: [c4 e4 g4 c5]*2.pianoroll() | bass: c2 ~ c2 ~ e2 ~.pianoroll() cps=0.5
announce 3/6: Pianoroll + Bar — different viz types
strudel edit melody: c4 e4 g4 c5.pianoroll() | rhythm: c4(3,8).bar() cps=0.7
announce 4/6: Three layers — pianoroll + bar + plain
strudel edit chords: [c3,e3,g3] [f3,a3,c4].pianoroll() | bass: c2 ~ e2 ~.bar() | drums: c5(3,8) cps=0.4
strudel edit strings: [c3,e3,g3] [f3,a3,c4] s=strings.pianoroll() | flute: [c4 e4 g4 c5]*2 s=flute.pianoroll() | bass: c2 ~ c2 ~ s=bass.bar() cps=0.35
announce 6/6: Full composition — 4 lines, all visualized
strudel edit pad: [c3,e3,g3] [f3,a3,c4] [g3,b3,d4] [c3,e3,g3] s=pad.pianoroll() | melody: [c4 e4 g4 c5]*2 s=flute.pianoroll() | bass: c2 ~ c2 ~ e2 ~ g2 ~ s=bass.bar() | rhythm: c5(5,8).bar() cps=0.3
notify {SCRIPT} "How did the visualizers look and sound?" ["Good","Issues","Broken"] {inspect} blocking
